crossRefs.note: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father…

translations.web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
translations.bsb: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior, and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city.
translations.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
translations.asv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.
